'''Alvorine City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alvorine]].

==Description==
Alvorine City was surrounded by [[Color/Legends|colorful]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] and large [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] spires.<ref name="THH" />

Alvorine City hosted the [[Government Offices]] of the [[Alvorine Authority]] and the [[Alvorine Authority Security Office]] of the [[Authority Security Forces]].<ref name="THH" />

A separate [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], [[Alvorine Spaceport]], was located on a mesa 20 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] north of the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="THH" />
